## Cooling Tower Design Parameter Definitions

The ranges quoted in this article describe what is commonly specified in practice, so that a reader can tell a conventional design point from an unusual one. They are orientation, not design values: the range and approach for a particular tower follow from the process duty and the site's design wet bulb, and the tower is then selected against them from the manufacturer's performance data.

edits.removed: - **Unrealistic Approach Goals:** Specifying an approach of 2°F or 3°F is often technically feasible but economically disastrous due to the massive tower size required.

Check the ambition against the manufacturer's selection before it is written into a specification.

edits.removed: Cooling towers typically last between 15 and 20 years when maintained under normal operating conditions. That said, this largely depends on factors like the type, overall build quality, and how well it is maintained. Here's a breakdown by material type:
edits.replaced_with: A cooling tower has no standard service life. What it achieves depends on the materials, the build quality, the water chemistry it runs in, the duty and the maintenance it receives, and towers of the same type diverge widely on those grounds alone. The material comparison below describes how each construction behaves, not how long it will last:

edits.removed: - **FRP (Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic):** Typically lasts 20+ years due to its corrosion-resistant properties. Its lightweight yet strong composition also reduces maintenance requirements over time.
edits.replaced_with: - **FRP (Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic):** Does not corrode in the way steel does, which removes the dominant deterioration mechanism in most cooling water service. It is light for its strength, so the supporting structure carries less load. Its condition is governed instead by UV exposure of unprotected laminate, resin chemistry and the quality of the original lay-up.

edits.removed: - **Galvanized Steel:** Generally lasts about 15–20 years, but heavily reliant on proper corrosion protection. However, exposure to salty or humid environments can accelerate wear, making routine inspections and maintenance critical to ensure longevity.
edits.replaced_with: - **Galvanized Steel:** Depends entirely on the zinc coating staying intact. Once the galvanizing is breached — by handling damage, cut edges, aggressive water chemistry or white rust in the first weeks of operation — the steel beneath corrodes. Coastal and high-chloride atmospheres accelerate this, which is why passivation on commissioning and routine inspection of the coating matter so much.

edits.removed: Replacement Makes Sense If: The tower is nearing the end of its lifespan, or repairs are more than 50% of replacement costs.
edits.replaced_with: Replacement Makes Sense If: The structure itself is degraded rather than individual components, or the cost and downtime of the repair approach that of replacement once the remaining useful life of the repaired tower is taken into account. That comparison has to be made on the actual quotations and the actual condition survey; there is no general percentage threshold.

edits.removed: Cooling tower fill media typically lasts 5 to 10 years, depending on water quality, scaling, algae buildup, and operational stress.
edits.replaced_with: Fill media has no standard replacement interval. Its life is governed by water quality, suspended solids, scaling, biological growth, water temperature and UV exposure, and the practical test is thermal performance and pack condition rather than elapsed time.

remediation_scope_correction.why_this_section_exists: The first draft of this overlay stated the remediation rule and then exempted the 22 technical articles as 'not over-compressed'. Both halves were true and the combination was not: the articles were not compressed, and they carried the claim shapes the rule says were removed and never carried forward. An adversarial review found a fabricated CTI certification for water treatment, an invented proprietary engineering standard, performance guarantees, unsupported statistics and internal build vocabulary, all live and rendering. The rule as written claimed an estate-wide result from a change that covered 2.6% of the estate's words. This section is the correction.
remediation_scope_correction.what_was_done: A claim-level remediation of the frozen article bodies, not a rewrite. Each edit below removes one unsupported claim and keeps the paragraph it sat in, which is exactly the rule the directive states. Seven bodies carry sixteen edits between them; the other fifteen articles needed none.

what_was_deliberately_not_done.flagged: Its heat-load reference table carries rows for HVAC commercial buildings, hospitals, breweries and cold storage, which a reviewer read as commercial-HVAC positioning.
what_was_deliberately_not_done.judgement: Left unchanged. The table is a reference of typical heat load and flow per ton by application — engineering data an article about heat load is supposed to carry — not a statement of markets ICS serves. Deleting rows from a reference table would be removing technical depth, which the directive forbids. Recorded here so the decision is visible rather than silent.
what_was_deliberately_not_done.open: If Control Tower reads that table as positioning rather than as reference, the rows can be removed on instruction.

remediation_scope_correction.quantitative_claims_retained_on_purpose: Twenty-five percentage figures appear across the 22 articles. Most are standard engineering and were kept: evaporation loss near 1% of circulating flow per 10 degF of range; a cooling tower ton being about 25% larger than a refrigeration ton; the fan cube law giving 87.5% energy reduction at half speed; CTI ATC-105 requiring load stable between 90 and 110% of design. Removing those would strip the articles of the content that makes them worth reading. What was removed is the unsourced marketing statistic: a 70% share of utility costs, a 30% efficiency loss, a 10-15 year life extension, a 50% failure reduction and a 70-90% water saving.
remediation_scope_correction.guarantee_terms_retained_on_purpose: Four occurrences of the word guarantee remain inside RT-0358 and are kept deliberately: 'thermal guarantee' and 'the original design guarantee' are the industry's own terms for the performance a tower's supplier contracted to, which is precisely what a CTI ATC-105 test measures against, and 'a fluctuating load will guarantee a failed test' is idiomatic. Removing the vocabulary of acceptance testing from an article about acceptance testing would be remediation doing damage. What was removed from that body is the one sentence that promised an outcome to the reader.

r2_1_od05_reconciliation.what_this_is: A complete claim-by-claim reconciliation of every OD05 row whose reviewer_role_required is SUBJECT_MATTER_EXPERT, against the rendered R2 bodies. The ledger is OD05_R2_RECONCILIATION.tsv.
r2_1_od05_reconciliation.authority_located: The directive names H2O_OD05_FACT_CHECK_AND_PUBLISHING_DECISIONS_2026-09-19_R1.xlsx. The factory holds that authority as CLAIM_INSTANCE_LEDGER.tsv inside the accepted package H2O_PHASE2_2D_LAUNCH_COHORT_CONTENT_REMEDIATION_AUTHORITY_2026-09-19_R1_3. No .xlsx was retrieved; the TSV is the same authority in the form the factory holds it, and the SME filter yields exactly the 1,962 rows the directive states.
r2_1_od05_reconciliation.severity_is_derived: The source ledger carries no severity column. Severity here is DERIVED from claim_class plus risk markers detected in the claim text, by the deterministic rule set in OD05_R2_RECONCILIATION_METHOD.md. Every marker that fired is recorded per row so the derivation is auditable rather than asserted.
r2_1_od05_reconciliation.what_unreconciled_means: A HIGH row is unreconciled if its disposition is outside the eight permitted values, if any mandated field is empty, if it rests on a rule-based default rather than an individual judgement, or if it was removed by a rewrite that could not be attributed to a named edit. Zero rows meet any of those tests.
r2_1_od05_reconciliation.not_a_deletion_pass: The twenty-two technical bodies grew by 1695 words across this pass. Sound engineering content was retained and, where it was under-scoped, qualified rather than deleted. Two segments were removed outright.
r2_1_od05_reconciliation.external_authority_retrieval: NOT_EXECUTED_FACTORY_ENVIRONMENT. Egress to standards bodies is denied from both the cloud container and the device VM, so no edition of ASHRAE Standard 188, ASHRAE Guideline 12, CTI ATC-105 or any other cited document was retrieved. Where a disposition depends on such a document, the row names it in primary_source_keys and records that it was not retrieved. Nothing in this ledger claims a standard was read.
